status: G1 pass condition decided by Dante (D28). Reading 'critical fields' as fields whose finding has critical severity is Proposed. Other gates are added in their phases.

G1.name: Order intake
G1.pass_when: Critical fields are consistent across their authoritative sources, with no missing or contradictory values.
notes: G1 never requires a field to be 'verified'. 'verified' is set by the data owner and is not a gate condition (D28).
A missing or contradictory field always raises a finding. The finding blocks G1 when its severity is in blocking_severities (SPEC 8.3); lower severities are reported and do not block.
